incidents.name: Nimbus StakingRewardFixedAPY reward price manipulation
incidents.notes: The Nimbus StakingRewardFixedAPY contracts convert a staker's accrued reward through the NimbusRouter's live NBU_WBNB/NIMB price, so a flash loan skewed that pool right before getReward() and multiplied the payout.

sources.ref: onchain review: StakingRewardFixedAPY 0x3aA2B9de4ce397d93E11699C3f07B769b210bBD5 created 2022-11-14T09:39:01Z by 0xf018fc651e8be8a2e09b216635aee561ce3c5ff7, unrelated to attack sender 0x86aa1c46f2ae35ba1b228dc69fb726813d95b597; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Two sibling LockStakingRewardFixedAPY contracts (0x7060657165..., 0xdEF57A7722...) were drained in the same transaction. lossUsd uses the ~$76k reported by DeFiHackLabs. Boundary row: the staking contracts behaved as coded and the attacker moved the Nimbus pool price they read.
